$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: Founder-approved 2026-10-08 (rc.6 option A + Next 16.3.8 security fix). rcTag does NOT move here (it stays v1.0.0-rc.5); this is the rc.6 changes PR, not the prepare/version PR. Frozen credential-harness files changed: (1) scripts/e2e-deploy.sh applies the Next < 16.4.0 adapterPath render404 workaround to the standalone tree before the bun heal/compile, via the new internal standalone-adapter-path export, and exits 1 if the module is missing on an affected Next (credential resets on parallel-routes-root-param-dynamic-child); (2) .github/workflows/test-e2e-deploy.yml moves NEXTJS_REF (dispatch default and env fallback) from v16.3.6 to v16.3.8 for GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4, EQUAL to the scaffold pin; (3) scripts/musl-native-lockfiles/next-sharp-resolution.json nextVersion follows to 16.3.8 (Next 16.3.8 keeps sharp ^0.35.4, so sharp 0.35.5 / libvips 1.3.4 and every committed musl lockfile are unchanged); (4) test/deploy-tests-manifest.knext.json re-stamps all 8 $knextQuarantines entries reaudited v16.3.8 on a stated source-equivalence basis (the v16.3.6...v16.3.8 compare touches no quarantined test file or fixture); (5) this file. Remove this marker once merged.

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Founder-approved 2026-10-08 (rc.6 option A + Next 16.3.8 security fix). Published bytes change on purpose for two reasons: (1) @getknext/core moves the scaffold template next pins (templates/app/package.json.hbs and the vinext template) and its own next devDependency from 16.3.6 to 16.3.8 for GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4 (HIGH, SSRF in Next.js Image Optimization, affects next >=16.0.0 <16.3.8), so every app scaffolded from rc.5 pins a vulnerable Next; (2) @getknext/core adds the Next < 16.4.0 adapterPath render404 workaround (a version-gated post-build step in knext build/deploy/preview, plus one internal subpath export, ./internal/standalone-adapter-path) which fixes a 500-under-burst on routes with dynamicParams = false. The version bump to 1.0.0-rc.6 is the separate prepare PR; remove this marker once the pinned rcTag moves to that rc.
